Proposition
[Intersection estimate in an end] 1. 9.3.3\group thurston.ch09.endingSource: thurston:page-0252 For curves $\alpha ,\beta $ in an end and their associated cylinders, $|\alpha \cap C_\beta |+|C_\alpha \cap \beta |\ge i(\alpha ',\beta ')$, where $\alpha ',\beta '$ are the corresponding boundary curves.
